source: 716 Bullets
target: 716 Globuli

source: Jebus, who had been about to explain the meaning of “Under the Table,” was caught off guard.
target: Jebus, qui iam intendebat significationem "Sub Mensa" explicare, insperatus comprehensus est.

source: “We’re putting in a lot of effort to keep the Carbonari in check and have made considerable headway.”
target: "Multum laboramus ut Carbonarios temperemus et ingentem profectum adepti sumus."

source: The School of Truth member chuckled at that.
target: Sodalis Scholae Veritatis huic risu effusus est.

source: “They’re attempting to topple the government and create their own system. That’s precisely the outcome we hope to see.”
target: "Governatio deleatur atque sui systema creetur conantur. Id ipsum est exitus quem speramus videre."

source: Jenna thought Jebus’s words didn’t add up.
target: Jenna censuit verba Jebus non congruere.

source: “But don’t you aim to slowly seize control of the government through high society individuals like Moran Avigny?”
target: "Nonne statuendum agis gubernationem lente capere per homines ex alta societate, ut Moran Avigny?"

source: Jebus laughed and adopted an instructive tone.
target: Jebus risit atque tonum eruditionis assumpsit.

source: “A wise merchant wouldn’t risk everything on a single venture. The same principle applies to exceptional Ambitionists.”
target: "Mercator prudens non totum in unam rem periclitaret. Eiusdem principium Ambitionistis praeclaris valet."

source: Hearing this, Lumian abruptly shifted the topic.
target: Hoc audito, Lumian repente rem mutavit.

source: “From what you’ve described, Ambitionists primarily enhance their bodies, perception, and spirituality. It doesn’t appear to involve their intellect?”
target: "Ex his quae dixeris, Ambitionistae praecipue corpora, sensum, et spiritualitatem augent; non videtur tamen intellectum tangere?"

source: Before Jebus could reply, Franca responded with a grin.
target: Priusquam Jebus responderet, Franca subridente respondit.

source: “Who says Ambitionists require intelligence? It’s not the same as being a Conspirer. Ambitionists prioritize ambition over the capability to actually achieve it. Exceptional intelligence isn’t a prerequisite for them. We’ve encountered many foolish ambitionists throughout history.”
target: "Quis ait Ambitionistas intelligentiam requirere? Non idem est ac conspirator esse. Ambitionistae ambitionem potius quam facultatem ad ea perficienda praeferri credunt. Intelligentia praeclara eis non necessaria est. Multos per historiam ineptos Ambitionistas convenerimus."

source: The pair’s back-and-forth left Jebus speechless.
target: Seriatim eorum disputatio Jebum sine verbis reliquit.

source: Fortunately, Lumian didn’t dwell on the subject.
target: Felix, Lumian de re non multum meditatus est.

source: He turned the conversation back to the Carbonari.
target: Colloquium ad Carbonarios redire constituit.

source: “Has Albert Goncourt already sided with you?”
target: "Num Albertus Goncourt iam tibi fautus sit?"

source: “Most likely,” Jebus answered uncertainly.
target: "Maxime verisimile," inquit Jebus incertus.

source: “I don’t handle the Carbonari.”
target: "Carbonarios non administrō."

source: “Was it because of you Brokers that the Dreamseekers charity group formed ties with the Carbonari?” Lumian thought of General Philip.
target: "Num propter vos, Negotiatores, coetus caritatis Dreamseekers cum Carbonari vincula instituit?" cogitavit Lumian de Generali Philippo.

source: Jebus grinned again.
target: Jebus iterum subridens respondit.

source: “Philip was a man with grand aspirations who had long aimed to bring various secret organizations together. As Brokers, Shadow Merchants, and Ambitionists, we definitely had to help him. Regrettably, while his scheme was successful, others took advantage of him. He also disappeared in the ancient underground city. Incidentally, I’m not sure if you know, but it’s actually Fourth Epoch Trier.”
target: "Philip vir magnarum aspirationum erat, qui diu diversa arcana collegiare contendebat. Ut Negotiatores, Mercatores Umbrae, et Ambitionistae, certe eum adiuvare debuimus. Infeliciter, dum consilium eius feliciter perrexit, alii eum exsueverunt. Etiam in antiqua urbe subterranea evanuit. Atqui, nescio num scias, sed revera est Trier, Quartum Aevum."

source: “You guys…”
target: "Vos, amici…"

source: Franca had a thought but kept it to herself. She merely sighed.
target: Franca quid cogitavit sed tacita remansit. Solem suspiravit.

source: Only then did Lumian inquire about Under the Table.
target: Tunc demum Lumian de "Sub Mensa" quaesivit.

source: “What extra capabilities do you gain at Sequence 5?”
target: "Quae facultates additas obtines in Sequentia V?"

source: Jebus kept his eyes fixed on the two Demonesses.
target: Jebus oculos in duabus Daemonessibus ferefixit.

source: “Under the Table is the sole ability, but there are two ways to utilize it:
target: "Sub Mensa sola facultas est, sed duo modi ad eam utendum sunt:

source: The first is to establish an unseen and tranquil Under the Table atmosphere in combat and emergency scenarios.
target: Primum, constituere oportet ambitum "Sub Mensa" invisibilem et quietum in pugna et in casibus emergentibus.

source: You can forcibly meet your demands by offering the enemy valuable items, but you can’t injure them or impact their state in any other way.
target: Exigere potes necessitates tuas vi, hosti pretiosa dona offerendo, sed neque eum laedere neque statum eius aliter afficere potes.

source: Additionally, you must behave normally.
target: Praeterea, se gerere debes more solito.

source: If not, the enemy who ‘agreed’ to the under‐the‐table deal can easily detect that something is amiss and snap out of it.
target: Alioquin, hostis qui pacto "Sub Mensa" consenserit, facile detegere potest aliquid esse non rectum et statim se extrahere.

source: Such Under the Table transactions aren’t guaranteed to work.
target: Talia commercia "Sub Mensa" non semper efficaciter funguntur.

source: The target’s inclination and experience in the gray domain determine the success rate.
target: Inclination et experientia destinatī in regione cinerea gradum successus determinant.

source: The Broker Sequence’s Gray Perception ability can assess this.
target: Facultas "Perceptio Cinerea" in sequentia Negotiatorum hoc aestimare potest.

source: If you’re up against an Unshadowed of the Sun pathway, success is nearly impossible even without the suppression of godhood.
target: Si adversus iter "Solis Nonumbratum" laborabis, successus paene impossibilis est, etiam sine deitatis suppressione.

source: Unshadowed referred to the Sun pathway’s Sequence 4.
target: "Nonumbratum" refertur ad viam Solis in sua quarta sequentia.

source: Lumian had a realization.
target: Lumian repente intellexit.

source: “You previously made me release you through such an Under the Table transaction?”
target: "Num olim me per talem transactionem 'Sub Mensa' te dimittere fecisti?"

source: “Correct,” Jebus said frankly. “You have extensive experience with the gray domain and a strong inclination in that respect.”
target: "Recte," dixerat Jebus aperte. "Amplam experientiam cum regione cinerea atque validam inclinationem in hoc habes."

source: On Lumian’s behalf, Franca complimented Jebus, saying, “You have a talent for reading people!”
target: Pro Luminiano, Franca Jebum laudavit, dicens: "Ingenium ad homines intellegendos tibi est!"

source: “Gray Perception may be an ability acquired as a Sequence 9 Broker, but it’s incredibly useful,” Jebus bragged, seeming objective.
target: "Perceptio Cinerea fortasse facultas est acquisita ut Negotiator in Sequentia IX, sed valde utilis est," iactavit Jebus, videns se obiectivum.

source: Jenna pressed, “And the other Under the Table transaction?”
target: Jenna instavit, "Et altera transactio 'Sub Mensa'?"

source: Jebus answered with a smile, “That requires a certain amount of time. It’s not suitable for combat or emergency situations.”
target: Jebus risu respondit, "Id aliquam temporis quantitatem postulat. Non est aptum ad pugnam aut casus emergentes."

source: In simple terms, we’ll utilize a barely sealed space as the operating target to create a genuine Under the Table scenario.
target: Simpliciter, spatium vix sigillatum ut propositum operandi ad verum casum "Sub Mensa" creandum adhibebimus.

source: We’ll be on one side of the transaction under this table.
target: Nos in una parte transactionis sub hac mensa erimus.

source: The mysterious creature or dangerous entity concealed in the shadows and darkness will be on the other side, but we won’t know their identity beforehand.
target: Mysteriosa creatura aut periculosa entitas in umbris et tenebris abscondita in altera parte erunt, sed eorum identitatem praevius nesciremus.

source: We also won’t be able to sense who the other party is during the transaction.
target: Etiam sentire non poterimus qua altera pars sit per transactionem.

source: It could be an entity we’ve previously dealt with or one from the unknown.
target: Potest esse entitas cum qua antea negociavimus aut ex incognito.

source: Essentially, in this Under the Table state, where you don’t know the counter‐party or how your needs will be fulfilled through the transaction, you can achieve the desired result by stating your request and offering the item the other party desires.
target: Revera, in hoc statu "Sub Mensa", ubi nec contrapartem nosti nec quomodo necessitates tuae per transactionem implebuntur, effectum desideratum assequi potes petitionem tuam enuntiando ac rem quam altera pars cupit offerendo.

source: How this is accomplished isn’t relevant.
target: Modus quo hoc efficiatur non refert.

source: “Can the transaction only involve two parties?”
target: "Possitne transactionem solum duas partes implicare?"

source: “No, it can be a three‐way deal, a four‐way deal, or even more. Just follow the Under the Table transaction rules.”
target: "Non, commercium esse potest triplex, quadruplex, vel etiam pluris. Modo regulas transactionis 'Sub Mensa' sequere."

source: Jebus didn’t hold back on sharing his mysticism knowledge.
target: Jebus nulla cunctatione scientiam mysticam communicare retinuit.

source: “The transaction may not succeed either.
target: "Transactio fortasse quoque non succedet.

source: It depends on the task’s difficulty and the limitations of the provided traded items.
target: Dependet ex difficultate muneris atque limitationibus rerum mercandarum praebitarum.

source: Also, don’t assume those mysterious creatures and dangerous entities will honor their promises.
target: Neque putes has mysteriosas creaturas et periculosas entitates suas promissiones observaturas esse.

source: There’s no lack of con artists among them who can find ways to circumvent Under the Table’s restrictions.”
target: Non carent inter eos fallaces qui vias invenire possunt ut restrictiones "Sub Mensa" circumveniant.

source: “Are there additional risks after using Under the Table to complete a particularly challenging task?”
target: "Suntne pericula addita postquam 'Sub Mensa' ad operandum munus praecipue arduum adhibetur?"

source: Jenna thought of her Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction.
target: Jenna cogitavit de transactione "Sub Mensa" a suo Titulari Auctoritate.

source: Jebus nodded gravely.
target: Jebus graviter annuit.

source: “Yes, it depends on which mysterious creature or dangerous entity helped you and if it has malicious intentions.
target: "Ita, dependet ex qua creatura mysteriis aut entitas periculosa te adiuvit, et utrum animo maligno sit.

source: I once had a week of misfortune and was almost caught by the Purifiers.”
target: Olim hebdomadem infelicitatis passa sum, et paene a Purificatoribus comprehensus sum.

source: Jenna nodded pensively and pondered inwardly: It seems the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction is a variant of the standard Under the Table ability.
target: Jenna pensim annuit et interius meditata est: Videtur transactionem "Sub Mensa" a Titulari Auctoritate esse variantem facultatis "Sub Mensa" ordinariae.

source: Instead of the counter‐party making the requests, it’s us offering something valuable.
target: Pro parte qua altera pars petitiones non facit, nos res pretiosas offerimus.

source: However, it can only simplify complex issues and ease difficult ones.
target: Attamen illa solum potest res complexas simplicari et arduas levare.

source: It can’t directly complete tasks.
target: Non poterit munera directe complere.

source: There are significant limitations…
target: Sunt limitationes notabiles…

source: The cost of using it is encountering a transaction involving Demons and other sinister beings…
target: Pretium huius usus est commercium cum Daemoniis aliisque entibus sinistris experiri…

source: “What information do you have about Overseers?”
target: "Quae notitia de Supervisoribus tibi nota est?"

source: Lumian posed a new question when he noticed the Under the Table discussion was nearly over.
target: Lumian quaestionem novam proposuit, cum animadvertit sermonem de "Sub Mensa" prope finem habere.

source: Jebus appeared troubled and didn’t answer.
target: Jebus sollicitus apparuit nec respondit.

source: Seeing this, Lumian switched topics.
target: Hoc videns, Lumian rem mutavit.

source: “What items are you carrying?”
target: "Quae res geris?"

source: Jebus glanced at Franca and took out a few assorted items from his concealed pocket.
target: Jebus Francam respexit et ex sinu absconso paucas res varias eduxit.

source: “This is a healing agent obtained from the Great Mother’s believers. These are the Coma Gas, Awakening Gas, and Confession Concoction acquired from the Mother Tree of Desire’s followers…”
target: "Hoc est medicamentum sanandum ex fidelibus Magnae Matris adeptum. Hi sunt Gas Comae, Gas Excitandi, et Concoctio Confessionis ab sectatoribus Arboris Matris Desiderii adepti…"

source: Healing agents, sedatives, mysticism smelling salts, and truth serum. These are all precious items…
target: Medicamenta sanantia, sedativa, salis odorati mystici, et serum veritatis. Haec omnia sunt res pretiosae…

source: Lumian gave a small nod at the four metal canisters with various labels.
target: Lumian parvum annuit ad quattuor vasculis metallicis cum variis inscriptionibus.

source: His gaze then moved to Jebus’s other palm, where six bullets rested.
target: Aspectus eius deinde ad alteram manum Jebus convertit, ubi sex globuli reposita erant.

source: The six bullets were brass, but their surface patterns and colors differed.
target: Sex globuli aerei erant, sed figurae superficiales et colores diversae erant.

source: One looked normal, one had a luminous tip, and one appeared to be corroded by potent acid.
target: Unus consuetus videbatur, unus apicem lucentem habebat, et unus potenti acido corrusum videbatur.

source: One flickered with a dark green light, one radiated a brilliant starlight, and another had a faint luster as if it had been matted many times.
target: Unus lumine viridi obscuro micabat, unus splendida luce stellarum fulgebat, et alter tenui nitorem ostendebat, quasi multis vicibus opacatus esset.

source: Jebus introduced them with enthusiasm, “These are the Impregnating Bullet, Poison Bullet, Putrid Bullet, Weakening Bullet, Implosion Bullet, and Deprivation Bullet. I traded for them from various deity believers.”
target: Jebus eos cum ardore introduxit, dicens: "Hi sunt Globulus Impregnans, Globulus Venenosus, Globulus Putridius, Globulus Debilitans, Globulus Implosivus, et Globulus Deprivans. Eos a variis cultoribus deorum per commercium adeptus sum."

source: Intrigued, Franca pointed at the ordinary bullet from a distance. “Is this the Impregnating Bullet?”
target: Curiosa, Franca ab longinquo globulum ordinum indicavit. "Estne hic Globulus Impregnans?"

source: “Indeed. People and animals shot by it will inevitably become pregnant, and the corresponding symptoms will swiftly manifest,” Jebus said, a tinge of fear in his voice.
target: "Certe. Homines et animalia eo icta necessario gravidabuntur, et symptomata consequens celeriter manifesta erunt," inquit Jebus, leviter timore in voce.

source: “It affects both males and females indiscriminately?” Franca inquired.
target: "Num et viros et feminas indiscriminanter afficit?" rogavit Franca.

source: “Yes,” Jebus said with certainty.
target: "Ita," respondit Jebus certo.

source: Huh… Franca made a sound conveying a mix of contempt, fear, and fascination.
target: Heu… Franca sonum edidit, qui contemptum, timorem, et admirationem simul exprimebat.

source: Jenna asked worriedly, “It looks like a regular bullet. What if there’s a mix-up?”
target: Jenna sollicite interrogavit, "Videor esse globulus ordinarius. Quid si confusio oritur?"

source: Jebus shook his head.
target: Jebus caput concussit.

source: “You won’t make that mistake. It’s lightweight, as if made of wood or soil.”
target: "Non errare hoc potes. Levis est, quasi ex ligno aut terra factus fuerit."

source: Phew… Lumian and Anthony let out a sigh of relief.
target: Heu... Lumian et Anthony suspirum levem edierunt.

source: Lumian pointed at the matte bullet.
target: Lumian globulum opacum indicavit.

source: “Is this the Deprivation Bullet? What does it do?”
target: "Estne hic Globulus Deprivans? Quid facit?"

source: The effects of the other bullets seemed straightforward, but Lumian wasn’t sure about the Deprivation Bullet’s purpose.
target: Effectus ceterorum globulorum simplices apparuerunt, sed Lumian de proposito Globuli Deprivantis incertus erat.

source: “Those struck or grazed by it will lose one Beyonder power within fifteen minutes. As for which one, it’s unpredictable,” Jebus answered honestly.
target: "Qui per illud icti vel adlatae erunt, unam potentiam Beyonder intra quindecim minuta amittent. Quod autem, incertum est," respondit Jebus sincero.

source: This can complement a Fate Appropriator’s abilities of designating the Deprivation…
target: Hoc complere potest facultates Fati Appropriatoris in designatione Deprivationis…

source: Lumian appraised Jebus and asked, “Do you have any other items? As a Shadow Merchant, don’t you possess any mystical objects?”
target: Lumian Jebum aestimavit et rogavit, "Habesne alias res? Ut Mercator Umbrae, nonne rerum mysticarum aliquas possides?"

source: Jebus explained embarrassedly, “I recently received the Under the Table boon. To complete the corresponding ritual and please truth, I traded all the items I had acquired, leaving only these.
target: Jebus verecunde explicavit, "Nuper beneficium 'Sub Mensa' accepi. Ad ritum correspondentem perficiendum et veritati placandam, omnes res quas adeptus eram commutavi, relinquens sola haec."

source: “A merchant’s rule is that you can buy and sell anything!”
target: "Regula mercatoris est: quidquid emere et vendere licet!"

source: Poor slob… Franca mocked disappointedly.
target: Pauper stulte... Franca deiecta irriduit.

source: She then said to Jebus, “Give us all these items. They’re the very reason you’ve been repeatedly caught up in danger and deity‐level conflicts. Hand them over, and you’ll be free. Once you’re safe, you can start anew.”
target: Tum Jebum adloquebatur, "Da nobis omnes has res. Ipsae sunt causa cur iterum atque iterum in periculum et ad deorum contentiones incidisti. Tradito eas, et liber eris. Postquam tibi securum fiet, iterum incipere poteris."

source: Similar to Anthony’s hypnotic words, Jebus chose to believe it and gave everything to Franca.
target: Sicut verba hypnotica Antonii, Jebus credere decrevit et omnia Francae tradidit.

source: After Franca stowed away the items, Lumian surveyed the area and asked, “Where is the School of Truth’s headquarters? Which Overseer do you report to?”
target: Postquam Franca res recondidit, Lumian locum perlustrare conatus est et rogavit, "Ubi est praetorium Scholae Veritatis? Cui Supervisori referis?"

source: Hearing these two questions, Jenna, Franca, and Anthony quietly moved to Lumian’s side.
target: His duabus quaestionibus auditis, Jenna, Franca, et Anthony silentio ad Luminianum accesserunt.

source: Jebus hesitated for a few seconds and was about to respond when his expression suddenly twisted.
target: Jebus paucis secundis dubitavit et iam responderet paratus erat, cum vultus eius subito contortus esset.

source: Seeing this, Lumian immediately said to Franca, “Toss the figurine over!”
target: Hoc videns, Lumian immediate Francae dixit, "Iace figuram trans!"

source: Franca followed suit.
target: Franca secuta est.

source: She took out the Primordial Demoness’s bone figurine from her Traveler’s Bag and threw it to Jebus.
target: Figurinam ossis Daemonissae Primordialis ex sacculo viatoris extraxit et Jebuso iecit.

source: At the same time, she, Anthony, and Jenna grabbed Lumian’s shoulders, arms, and other positions.
target: Simul, illa, Anthony, et Jenna humeros, brachia, et alia Lumiani loca apprehenderunt.

source: In the next instant, the four of them disappeared.
target: In momento secundo, quattuor eorum evanuerunt.

source: Boom!
target: Pum!

source: Jebus exploded from the inside out, his shattered flesh merging with the pale‐white fog, transforming into a peculiar blood mist.
target: Jebus ex intus ad foras explosus est, caro eius fracta cum nebula pallide alba miscens, in insolitam sanguinis nebulam transmutata.

source: The blood fog slowly descended, circling the Primordial Demoness’s bone figurine before seeping into the soil.
target: Nebula sanguinea lente descendebat, figuram ossis Daemonissae Primordialis circuitans, antequam in terram infunderetur.

source: After a few seconds, Lumian and the others teleported back.
target: Post paucas secundos, Lumian et ceteri iterum apparuerunt.
